title: ROC (Taiwan) and Philippines sign updated MOU on direct hiring
text:
On November 5, Ambassador Wallace Minn-gan Chow, Representative of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in the Philippines, and Corazon Avecilla-Padiernos, Chairperson and Resident Representative of the Manila Economic and Cultural Office in Taiwan, signed an updated version of the memorandum of understanding (MOU) on the Special Hiring Program in Taiwan (SHPT). The signing took place in Taiwan and was witnessed by Chen Ming-jen, Vice Minister of Labor of Taiwan, and Jainal Rasul Jr., Undersecretary of the Department of Migrant Workers of the Philippines.

Cooperation between Taiwan and the Philippines on labor affairs has continued to deepen over the years. The latest MOU on the SHPT marks a milestone in promoting fair recruitment and reducing the burden on both employers and employees. The arrangement between the two governments will allow employers in Taiwan to directly hire outstanding Filipino talent, further expanding recruitment channels for Taiwanese enterprises.

Taiwan’s active promotion of integrated diplomacy has continued to strengthen collaboration between Taiwan and the Philippines, producing tangible results across all spheres and laying solid foundations for both sides to advance shared prosperity and development. (E)
